using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.IO;
using MediaBrowser.Model.IO;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace MediaBrowser.Controller.IO.Tests
{
    public class FileSystemHelperTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<IFileSystem> _mockFileSystem;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<FileSystemHelper>> _mockFileSystemHelperLogger;

        public FileSystemHelperTests()
        {
            _mockFileSystem = new Mock<IFileSystem>();
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            _mockFileSystemHelperLogger = new Mock<ILogger<FileSystemHelper>>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteFile_FileSystemThrowsUnauthorizedAccessException_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "/test/path/file.txt";
            var exception = new UnauthorizedAccessException("Access denied");
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.DeleteFile(path)).Throws(exception);

            // Act
            FileSystemHelper.DeleteFile(_mockFileSystem.Object, path, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex == exception),
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteFile_FileSystemThrowsIOException_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "/test/path/file.txt";
            var exception = new IOException("IO error");
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.DeleteFile(path)).Throws(exception);

            // Act
            FileSystemHelper.DeleteFile(_mockFileSystem.Object, path, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex == exception),
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteEmptyFolders_EmptyDirectory_ThrowsIOException_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "/test/path";
            var subDir = "/test/path/subdir";
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(path)).Returns(new[] { subDir });
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(subDir)).Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetFileSystemEntryPaths(subDir)).Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());

            var ioException = new IOException("Cannot delete directory");
            // Mock Directory.Delete to throw IOException
            // Since Directory.Delete is static, we verify the logger was called

            // Act & Assert - we expect the logger to be called with IOException
            // The static Directory.Delete call will throw in real execution, but we verify the log call pattern
            _mockFileSystemHelperLogger.Setup(l => l.LogError(It.IsAny<IOException>(), "Error deleting directory {Path}", subDir));

            Assert.ThrowsAny<IOException>(() => FileSystemHelper.DeleteEmptyFolders(_mockFileSystem.Object, path, _mockFileSystemHelperLogger.Object));

            // Verify the specific LogError call for IOException on directory
            _mockFileSystemHelperLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.Is<IOException>(ex => ex.Message == "Cannot delete directory"),
                    "Error deleting directory {Path}",
                    subDir
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteEmptyFolders_EmptyDirectory_ThrowsUnauthorizedAccessException_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "/test/path";
            var subDir = "/test/path/subdir";
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(path)).Returns(new[] { subDir });
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(subDir)).Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetFileSystemEntryPaths(subDir)).Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());

            var unauthException = new UnauthorizedAccessException("Access denied");

            // Act & Assert
            Assert.ThrowsAny<UnauthorizedAccessException>(() => FileSystemHelper.DeleteEmptyFolders(_mockFileSystem.Object, path, _mockFileSystemHelperLogger.Object));

            // Verify the specific LogError call for UnauthorizedAccessException on directory (line ~60 equivalent)
            _mockFileSystemHelperLogger.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.Is<UnauthorizedAccessException>(ex => ex.Message.Contains("Access denied")),
                    "Error deleting directory {Path}",
                    subDir
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteEmptyFolders_NoDirectories_Success()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "/test/path";
            _mockFileSystem.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryPaths(path)).Returns(Enumerable.Empty<string>());

            // Act
            FileSystemHelper.DeleteEmptyFolders(_mockFileSystem.Object, path, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert - no exceptions thrown, no logs expected for errors
            _mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
        }
    }
}
